FREELANCE DESIGN AGREEMENT

This Freelance Design Agreement (the "Agreement") is made on October 2, 2026 between Lindqvist Studio AB, a company registered in Sweden (the "Client"), and Arjun Mehta, an individual resident in Bengaluru, India (the "Designer").

1. Work

1.1 The Designer will create the brand identity described in Schedule 1 (the "Deliverables"), with two rounds of revisions included.

2. Fees and Payment

2.1 The Client will pay the Designer a fixed fee of EUR 7,200: 40% before work starts and 60% on delivery of the final files.

2.2 The Designer will invoice in EUR. The Client will pay each invoice in full within 15 days of the invoice date, and each party bears its own bank's charges.

2.3 Overdue invoices carry interest at 1.5% per month. If an invoice is more than 15 days late, the Designer may pause work until it is paid.

3. Ownership

3.1 Upon receipt of payment in full of all fees, the Designer assigns to the Client all copyright in the final Deliverables. Until then, the Client may use the Deliverables for review only.

3.2 The Designer keeps all pre-existing materials and may show the final work in a portfolio.

4. Other clients

4.1 Nothing in this Agreement stops the Designer from working for other clients, during or after the project.

5. Ending the Agreement

5.1 Either party may end this Agreement on 14 days' written notice. If the Client ends it, the Client will pay for all work done up to the end date plus 25% of the fees for the remaining work.

6. Disputes

6.1 The parties will first try to settle any dispute by video call. If that fails, the dispute will be settled by online arbitration under the rules of the Mumbai Centre for International Arbitration, with hearings held by video, and the law of India applies.

Signed by both parties on the date above.
